_: Who this fork is. Read by fork/pack.mjs, fork/sync.mjs, fork/installer/*, fork/install-shortcut.ps1 (through fork/identity.cjs) and, at build time, by product-identity.cjs and vite.config.ts (through the HERMES_FORK_IDENTITY variable the scripts set). Names only: the userData folder and the single-instance lock stay Hermes' own on purpose, so Hermoso, Hermes (Mullvad) and the official Hermes never run two backends on one profile.
